text:
[NERR.1.1] Every libds call reports its outcome the same way: a status code,
and optionally a sentence for a human.

The status is a plain integer rather than an enumeration, and that is
deliberate -- the value is what travels, through an FFI boundary, a log line,
or whatever transport the integrator builds ([RARC.3.3.3]), unchanged. Zero is success, negatives are errors, and
positives are unused ([NERR.1.3]). The code's **number** is the normative
part; a symbolic name is this implementation's convenience, and another
implementation is free to spell it however its language prefers so long as the
number and the meaning stay put ([IERR.2]).

The detail is the diagnostic half: short English, present or absent, and never
something to branch on ([NERR.1.2]).
